pr_body:
Fixes #36087 

The test was sending the wrong object which made it behave differently on arm64 and x64 archs. This fix will now send a valid payload that matches the format, which could now be converted and should have the same expected values across OSes and platforms.

cc: @bartonjs

review_comments: Nit: to be consistent we could use PlatformDetecion.IsWindows

That is what I initially had on my original PR, but @bartonjs suggested to use RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform instead (which is what PlatformDetection is doing anyways). I'm happy to change it either way, don't really have a preference, although this whole test assmbly is using RuntimeInformation so if we want to change it I'll  have to do it for the rest of the test project.
Ok, leave as is for the reason that all the test assembly uses it that way, but I believe most of the test assemblies use PlatformDetection, either way is fine.
